name: riffkit
description: Load when the user wants a short video made from a proven one: rebuilds that video's formula into their own product video, optional character and placement.
notes: Changes external state and uses a credential: the agent sends an API key to riffkit.ai and creates rendering jobs that consume the account's paid balance. It executes no downloaded code; the only host it contacts is riffkit.ai. Writes are downloaded result files in the workspace.
